simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֶגֶב (H5690) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עֶגֶב (ʻegeb) means love (concretely), i.e. amative words First listed occurrence: Ezek 33 31.

definitions.full: H5690. agab [ עָגָב ] noun [masculine] (sensuous) love (on form compare Lag BN 143 ); — only plural intensive עֲגָבֹים שִׁיר Ezek 33:32 thou art to them as a love-song . — For עֲגָבִים 33:31 read ᵑ6 ᵐ5 כְּזָבִים Co Berthol Toy.
